svg.title: What an extra £500 into a pension could mean
svg.desc: Illustration at age 35, salary £80,000, salary sacrifice. £290 less take-home each month; £500 extra monthly contribution; £319,325 extra total pension pot at 67. These amounts have different units.

g.text: A monthly decision. A long-term difference.
Age 35 → 67 · £80k salary · 3% real growth · 4% withdrawal rate
Employer contribution unchanged. No fees. Future figures in today’s money.
Take-home cost is today’s; NI savings change from April 2029. Estimates, not guarantees.
